children.text: Participants
ThinkByte: Niharika Chavati, vinay kovvuri, Charan
Sruteeshkumar
Raviteja Bingi
Key Takeaways
The meeting focused on resolving issues related to the gaming platform's layout, functionality, and API integration.
Discussed problems included missing game cards, repeated gamer handle requests, API response issues, and layout inconsistencies.
Follow-up actions involve fixing game card visibility, resolving API discrepancies, and adjusting UI elements by the end of the day.
Decisions were made to enhance user experience by addressing technical issues and improving interface consistency across devices.
Action Items
Speaker 1
Investigate why the selected icons are not being highlighted despite assigning the same logo color.
Enhance tournament registration flow and user experience.
Finish implementing the scroller and update the code by the end of today.
Update API responses for image and player count.
Speaker 2
Ensure API and UI alignment for tournament flows.
Address issues with tournament registration flow and user interface.
Send the parameter as attack instead of attack mode.
Complete the points discussed with Nirmika.
Speaker 3
Prepare and review design updates.
Enhance UI design elements.
Navbar and Sidebar Functionality
Improve sidebar functionality for logged-in users, ensuring it appears as intended on different devices.
Sidebar not displaying correctly; mobile navbars need removal in logged-out state to reduce clutter.
Implement sidebar that appears on right side for logged-in users; remove mobile navbars for logged-out users.
Game Card Inclusion
Reinstate game cards on listing and tournament pages for better navigation and selection.
Ensure game cards present on tournament and listing pages for game selection, but removed from landing page to streamline user experience.
Game cards were mistakenly removed from listing pages, making game selection difficult for users.
API Response and Image Issues
API responses for next match cards contain duplicate images and names, leading to incorrect rendering.
Update API endpoints ensure unique image names are returned, utilized correctly.
Address API discrepancies leading to repeated images, names in match cards, affecting display of unique content.
Leaderboard API Functionality
Leaderboard API access issues persist, particularly in logged-out state, affecting visibility of rankings.
Ensure leaderboard API functions for both logged-in and logged-out users, addressing access issues.
Fix API access issues in logged-out state, ensuring leaderboard is visible regardless of user status.
Tournament Registration Flow
Enhance tournament registration flow for seamless user experience by addressing issues with gamer handle requests.
Users encounter repeated requests for gamer handles during registration, interrupting flow.
Ensure automatic registration after gamer handle entry and fix UI discrepancies like duplicated CTAs.
User Handle Registration Issues
Users face repeated requests to enter gamer handles during tournament registration, causing confusion and frustration.
Resolve issues with gamer handle registration process, where system prompts repeatedly for gamer handles.
Implement automatic registration process after gamer handle entry to avoid repeated prompts.
Current Player Count Display
Implement display of current player count with appropriate player icons on tournament cards for clarity.
Replace placeholder text with current player count and use appropriate player icons for better clarity.
Incorrect display parameters for player count on tournament cards, leading to user confusion.
Mobile vs. Web UI Adjustments
Remove top scroll elements on mobile, adjust sidebar and navbar for better compatibility across devices.
Make necessary UI adjustments for mobile and web versions to maintain consistency and usability.
UI elements display inconsistently between mobile and web versions, affecting user experience.
Padding and Responsivity Adjustments
Adjust padding for better responsiveness across devices, ensuring elements are well-spaced and readable.
Padding settings not optimized for different screen sizes, leading to layout issues on smaller devices.
Reduce padding and ensure flexible text elements for optimal display on various devices, focusing on smaller screens.
Currency Symbol Alignment
Align currency symbols with text for consistency across all platforms, ensuring visual coherence.
Currency symbols misaligned with text, causing inconsistency in presentation, especially across different devices.
Ensure currency symbols match font size and alignment with text across web and mobile platforms for uniformity.
Pain Point
The API is not getting called due to a blocked out state.
The universal API access is not improving, and rewards are not appearing on the page.
Marketplace rewards are not displaying on the page as expected.
The pop-up became small.
The pop-up size issue persists despite multiple attempts to resolve it.
The initial attempt to add a gamer hand is failing, succeeding only on the second try.
The system repeatedly asks for the gamer handle despite already being registered.
Changing the placement of the top scroll is blocking the login and potentially obstructing the cards as well.
In mobile view, the top navbar hamburger menu is not optimized and causes issues.
